from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Citation(BaseModel):
    """A reference found in a document's bibliography."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the cited paper")

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """The paper being parsed and its extracted references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being parsed")
    references: list[Citation] = Field(description="List of citations found in the bibliography of this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed data for a single document."""
    papers: list[Paper]
